title: Audi Sport — identity film

location.series: KMS TEAM / Audi and Audi Sport identity case study

slide_intent: Intensify a shared identity for a distinct audience so a sub-brand can feel different while remaining part of the same family.
strategic_value: Red-dominant typography, assertive phrases and disrupted imagery can give Audi Sport a more forceful character than the parent identity.
demonstration: The 44.32-second film sequences Audi and Audi Sport signatures, neutral and red palette strips, uppercase statements, split imagery, driving footage and digital applications.
practical_value: Compare the sub-brand’s use of color, imagery and editing with the parent Audi film AU01.

content_islands.name: Family and palette
content_islands.spec: Introduce the Audi Sport signature and shift from the parent color family to red-dominant fields.

content_islands.name: Campaign sequence
content_islands.spec: Overlay short red uppercase statements on people, driving and high-contrast scenes, including split or offset images.

content_islands.name: Applications and closure
content_islands.spec: Show responsive digital examples before returning to driving footage and the red Audi Sport signature.

reference_purposes.Expression: The film combines red uppercase statements, disrupted images and fast driving footage.
reference_purposes.Application: Tablet, phone and website examples show how the sub-brand treatment is used.
reference_purposes.Intent: KMS’s More attitude under the hood section explicitly describes Audi Sport as a more intense, distinctive expression within the Audi ecosystem.
